text:
jia: Quick thought 1: can we ship a very compact 'model signal' card in the console that shows token burn, cache credit applied, and a back-of-envelope unit cost for last 1h/24h?

matt: sounds useful. differs from the larger ROI widget how?

jia: lean: one-line per-model card with a tiny sparkline + a hover panel. primary constraint: render in <200ms on console list view.

anya: product asks we surface both raw counts and normalized cost (per 1k tokens). two toggles?

jia: default: normalized cost per 1k tokens, hover shows raw tokens + breakdown. Columns: model_name, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, effective_cost_usd_per_1k, latency_p50.

sara: we need to factor routing multipliers and dedicated amortization so teams don't get a misleading low cost. Include an "apply accounting multipliers" option in the hover. Off by default.

matt: backend concern: analytics aggregates are sampled. do we hit clickhouse each page load? we should avoid that.

analytics-bot: FYI current per-model aggregates live in clickhouse table model_burn_agg with a 5s rollup window. sampling_rate=0.1 for many high-card tenants.

anya: given sampling, show a confidence indicator on the card and explain sampling coverage in the tooltip. gray out if sample_fraction < 0.2.

jia: agreed. UX should show a patterned confidence badge (color + texture) and tooltip: "estimate based on sampled telemetry (x% coverage)".

sara: quotas will bias numbers down when a tenant is throttled. Suggest tagging the card with a small "quota-limited" badge that links to the quota timeline view.

matt: implementation idea: router emits quota_event counts per tenant/minute. Join on tenant_id to flag quota-limited windows.

jia: API sketch: 
GET /internal/console/v1/model_signal?model=redwood/fast-1&tenant=acme&window=1h
response: model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, effective_cost_usd, sample_fraction, quota_limited
Notes: return should be a small JSON payload. populate via a low-latency cache (redis) updated by a streaming upsert job from clickhouse aggregates.

matt: +1 to cache. Also pull p50 latency from TSDB TTL=60s. Debounce reads per session to avoid load.

anya: rollout plan: internal preview only. opt-in toggle in console. track expand CTR to validate usefulness.

sara: for bookkeeping, add a nightly reconcile job that computes authoritative costs in batch and links console cards to invoice view for auditing.

jia: ops risk: consoles could fan-out many requests and overwhelm router; mitigate with server-side render of snapshot in console backend, fetch once per page load per session, cache per 30s per tenant. Enforce read quotas in console backend.

matt: will prototype endpoint + cache; may ask infra for extra clickhouse indices if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/mini-model-signal -> staging at 2026-03-23T15:12:00Z

anya: accessibility note: confidence badge must be color-blind safe (patterns + color).

jia: next steps: matt prototype, anya mock UX states (high/low sample, quota-limited), sara write reconciliation spec. I'll draft an RFC and short PRD. :thumbsup:
